package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// scenario for sqlx_select_large_slice_without_limit: sqlx.Select used on request paths without a visible LIMIT in the query.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type User struct {
	ID    int    `db:"id"`
	Name  string `db:"name"`
	Email string `db:"email"`
}

func scenario299Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	db, err := sqlx.Connect("postgres", "host=localhost dbname=app sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "db connection failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer db.Close()

	var users []User
	if err := db.Select(&users, "SELECT * FROM users"); err != nil {
		log.Printf("query failed: %v", err)
		http.Error(w, "query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	_ = users
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
